english_text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
tigrinya_text: ቅድም መንግስቲ ኣምላኽን ጽድቁን ድለዩ፡ እዚ ኹሉ ድማ ይውሰኸልኩም።

english_text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
tigrinya_text: ምሳኻ እየ እሞ፡ ኣይትፍራህ፡ ኣነ ኣምላኽካ እየ እሞ፡ ኣይትሸበር፡ ከበርትዓካ፡ ክረድኣካ፡ ብየማነይቲ ኢድ ጽድቀይውን ክድግፈካ እየ።

english_text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
tigrinya_text: ብተስፋ ተሐጐሱ፡ ብጸበባ ተዓገሱ፡ ጸሎት ኣዘውትሩ።

english_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
tigrinya_text: ኣምላኽ፡ በቲ ሓደ ወዱ ዝኣመነ ዅሉ ናይ ዘለኣለም ህይወት ምእንቲ ኺረክብ እምበር፡ ከይጠፍእሲ፡ ንወዱ በጃ ኽሳዕ ዚህብ፡ ክሳዕ ክንድዚ ንዓለም ኣፍቀራ።

english_text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
tigrinya_text: ቃልካ ንእግረይ መብራህቲ፡ ንመገደይ ብርሃን እዩ።

english_text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
tigrinya_text: ኣምላኽ ንኣና መዕቈብን ሓይልን፣ ብጸበባ ፍጡን ረድኤትን እዩ።

english_text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
tigrinya_text: ኣቱም ኵልኹም እትጽዕሩን ጾር ዝኸበደኩምን፡ ኣነ ኸዕርፈኩም ናባይ ንዑ።

english_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
tigrinya_text: ነቶም ንኣምላኽ ዜፍቅሩ፡ ከም ምኽሩውን እተጸውዑ ግና ኵሉ ንሰናዮም ከም ዚድግፎም፡ ንፈልጥ ኢና።

english_text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
tigrinya_text: ጽናዕ፡ ትባዕ፡ ኢለዶ ኣይኣዘዝኩኻን፧ እግዚኣብሄር ኣምላኽካ፡ ኣብ እትኸዶ ዅሉ ምሳኻ እዩ እሞ፡ ኣይትፍራህ ኣይትሸበር ከኣ።

english_text: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
tigrinya_text: ብምሉእ ልብኻ ብእግዚኣብሄር ተኣመን፡ ኣብ ልቦናኻ ኣይትጸጋዕ።

english_text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
tigrinya_text: እቶም ንእግዚኣብሄር ዚጽበዩ ግና ሓይሎም ይሕደስ። ከም ንስሪ በኽናፍ ይድይቡ፡ ይጐዩ እሞ ኣይሕለሉን፡ ይኸዱ እሞ ኣይደኽሙን።

english_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
tigrinya_text: ኣነ ዝሐስበልኩም ዘሎኹ ሓሳብ እፈልጦ እየ፡ መፈጸምታን ተስፋን ክህበኩምሲ፡ ሓሳብ ደሓን እምበር፡ ናይ ክፉእ ኣይኰነን፡ ይብል እግዚኣብሄር።

english_text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
